decision: Source-only review passed for retaining an inactive diagnostic and experiment bundle; no production fix or qualification is established.

independent_checks.v3_vs_v2: identical source variants, source pins, job pins and patches; changes limited to ELF helper, documentation and corresponding verifier/receipt generation
independent_checks.elf_synthetic_header_and_fake_binutils_c: passed without native binutils or real ELF
independent_checks.v2_different_architecture_header_swap_co: reproduced against v2; rejected by v3
independent_checks.file_change_during_fake_inspection: v3 rejects before producing a report

observational_and_use_limits: Connector-decoded/re-encoded job logs report classic-join phase followed by stack overflow and SIGABRT; no completed RPC, cause, crashing frame or precise thread stack mapping is established.

Future-state size and disassembly prologues do not measure required or maximum live stack. Trace logging and boxing alter the binary, allocation, timing and execution; outcomes of interventions cannot alone prove which frame caused failure.
The prior 2 MiB mock results are from other group source hashes and omit the complete live caller; they do not establish safety of the current live test.
The diagnostic 8 MiB test must be explicitly selected and requires its completion marker and successful exit. It is not a normal-stack gate.

The ELF parser checks selected x86_64 header fields, not comprehensive ELF validation; final binutils execution remains untested. Hash checks and separate opens do not prevent replace-and-restore, so the documented private quiescent snapshot is required.
No Cargo, compiler, native Rust tests, actual ELF/binutils inspection, live Kafka run or benchmark was performed in this review. No root file was modified.
